validation_dimensions.scope: IE -> W_DEV -> Sandbox -> Sub-agents -> HITL -> Provenance -> DEV-REL -> Final IE handoff
validation_dimensions.details: Full progression through planning, CMS, UI, Code, Verification, Security, and Release packaging with deterministic state machine transitions, Ed25519 HITL signoffs, and W3C PROV chain generation.
Strict validation that conflicting lease owners cannot usurp active execution leases, and concurrent sub-agents are capped to exactly 1.
Successor sub-agents strictly fail-closed with PolicyViolationError upon predecessor artifact hash tampering or mismatched candidate digest.

validation_dimensions.scope: Plan step skipping and mandatory gate preservation
validation_dimensions.details: Non-applicable authoring sub-agents (DEV-CMS) safely skipped without compromising mandatory downstream gates (DEV-VERIFY, DEV-SEC, DEV-REL).

validation_dimensions.scope: HITL revision requests and artifact immutability
validation_dimensions.details: Rejected deliverables remain immutable with distinct SHA-256 hashes, producing a new candidate snapshot on correction attempt.
Transient sandbox failures trigger bounded retry up to max_attempts with exponential backoff, while terminal policy violations immediately transition to FAILED without retry.
Simulated ungraceful crash and recovery using DiskTaskStateRepository; in-flight task correctly hydrated, duplicate transition deduplicated idempotently, and workflow safely completed.

validation_dimensions.scope: S_CODE capability boundary and path traversal defense
validation_dimensions.details: W_DEV strictly restricted to SandboxCapability.CODE. Unauthorized capabilities (BROWSING, SOCIAL, ADS, PAYMENT) and path traversal mutations are rejected.

validation_dimensions.scope: Ed25519 digital signatures and token lifecycle
validation_dimensions.details: Approval tokens validated for cryptographic authenticity; expired tokens, tampered snapshot hashes, and replay attacks across distinct task IDs fail closed.
Unbroken cryptographic hash chain, Ed25519 control-plane signatures on every development event, and valid prov:wasDerivedFrom graph relations verified.

validation_dimensions.scope: Machine DENY override of human approval
validation_dimensions.details: Verification FAIL or SecurityReview DENY blocks release packaging fail-closed, even if an operator attempts manual HITL APPROVE.

validation_dimensions.scope: DEV-REL scope and Intelligence Engine boundary
validation_dimensions.details: DEV-REL packages artifacts, SBOMs, and rollback manifests without executing live deployments; production actuation remains strictly under Intelligence Engine control.

defect_remediations.defect: Development checkpoints were stored in volatile in-memory dictionary and not hydrated from durable task.cts_state on process restart, breaking idempotency deduplication across process crashes.
defect_remediations.resolution: Hydrated dev_checkpoints history from durable task.cts_state on restart and added get_development_checkpoints API for durable inspection.

defect_remediations.defect: Generated plan hardcoded static template filenames in affected_artifacts instead of respecting grant.target_files.
defect_remediations.resolution: Updated plan generation to propagate grant.target_files dynamically into UI and Code plan steps.

defect_remediations.defect: execute_step omitted previous_candidate from predecessor resolution and CodeCandidateDeliverable was missing from isinstance predecessor checks.
defect_remediations.resolution: Added previous_candidate support and CodeCandidateDeliverable check in predecessor candidate resolution.

defect_remediations.defect: Sandbox result output extraction only inspected sanitized_output and crashed when raw_findings was a JSON-serialized string.
defect_remediations.resolution: Updated _invoke_sandbox to prefer structured_output and added defensive JSON parsing for stringified findings payloads.
